title: Remodeler AI Discovery — High-Ticket Ops
notes: Spoken text is in `body` with annotations stripped. `raw` keeps the original delivery annotations so they can be re-parsed. `summary` is what the semantic tracker matches against.

blocks.label: Set the Frame
blocks.summary: Sets the frame: not here to pitch today, only wants to learn how the firm operates day-to-day, will build a live prototype if there is a clear win and say so straight if not.
blocks.raw: Hey [Name], appreciate you carving out the time. [⬇️ DOWN] Just to set the stage, I'm not here to pitch you today. [⬇️ DOWN] I really just want to learn how the firm operates day-to-day. If I see a clear way AI can save you hours or add revenue, I'll build a live prototype for you to see next time. If not, I'll tell you straight and we part ways. [⏸️ 1s] Sound fair? [🤔 CURIOUS]

blocks.label: Personal Time Drain

blocks.label: Three Operational Leaks
blocks.summary: Clinical diagnosis: the trade work is not the bottleneck. Names three operational leaks — delayed lead catching while on site, relying on referrals instead of automating Google reviews from past projects, and evening admin bleed — totalling about $15k left on the table every month.
blocks.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Okay, I've got a really good picture of how things run. [⬇️ DOWN] Honestly [Name], your actual trade work isn't the bottleneck at all. Looking at your workflow, you have three specific operational leaks: [⬇️ DOWN] First, the delay in catching leads when you're busy on site. Second, relying on referrals instead of turning your past projects into automated Google reviews. And third, that evening admin bleed. [⏸️ 1.5s] If you add those up, you're easily leaving $15k on the table every month. [⬇️ DOWN] [⏸️ 2s] Does that diagnosis feel spot-on to you? [🤔 CURIOUS]
